stories.title: Meta's Muse exposes users' secrets through shared conversations as the chart-topping agent's troubles pile up

- New: Ars Technica found that a single query surfaces thousands of shared Muse conversations by title, exposing users' personal and business secrets

- Gizmodo reports Meta tested a "human concierge" of contractors making Muse's phone calls, one of whom reportedly made racist remarks
- Muse reached iPad a month after its mobile debut; Meta admits it was "heavily inspired" by OpenClaw, and Amazon has blocked it from shopping on Amazon.com
